title: MCA-Backed IICA Forms Advisory Group To Simplify Corporate Regulations And Ease Of Doing Business
text:
News Brief
Arjun Brij
Feb 19, 2026 | Updated 10:13 AM GMT+5:30

The Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs (IICA), operating under the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA), has constituted a high-level Advisory Group on Ease of Doing Business (EoDB) to modernise India’s corporate regulatory framework.
The panel, chaired by Gyaneshwar Kumar Singh, Director General and CEO of IICA, has been formed following the Ministry’s order dated 31 December 2025 and is aligned with the national vision of Viksit Bharat @2047.
The initiative signals a renewed push to simplify compliance procedures under the Companies Act, 2013, and strengthen India’s position as a globally competitive investment destination.
The Advisory Group will focus on rationalising e-forms, reducing procedural duplication and embedding technology-driven governance mechanisms into corporate administration.
Among its key responsibilities, the panel will recommend measures to ease regulatory burdens, streamline filings through consolidation and automation, and explore event-based compliance systems.
It will also design an Integrated Form Blueprint aimed at improving user experience and enhancing regulatory clarity for businesses.
The Group has been tasked with assessing the feasibility of reforms and preparing a phased roadmap for implementation.
It will conduct stakeholder consultations to ensure participatory policy development and undertake impact assessments to evaluate improvements in compliance efficiency.
Draft amendments to the Companies Act and related rules may also be proposed to support a transparent, technology-enabled regulatory ecosystem.
The Advisory Group comprises senior officials from the MCA, leading academics from national institutions, industry representatives, legal experts, and members from professional bodies including ICAI, ICSI, ICMAI, CII, FICCI and ASSOCHAM.
The School of Business Environment at IICA will serve as its Secretariat.
In parallel, IICA has signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the MCA to undertake a research study titled “Re-envisioning Ease of Doing Business for Viksit Bharat 2047,” aimed at generating evidence-based policy recommendations.
Arjun Brij is a Newsroom Associate at Swarajya. He tweets at @arjun_brij
